name: mnemonic_echo_bloom
label: Mnemonic Echo Bloom
godotFeature: Spatial and CanvasItem shaders with screen_texture and custom HDR/bloom pipeline
poeticVision: Feel the overwhelming rush of a lost identity flooding back – a brief, blinding supernova of forgotten details, colors, and textures that momentarily saturates your senses, blurring the lines between memory and reality. It's beautiful, but almost too much to bear, a fragile and disorienting burst of self in a decaying void.

parameters.name: progress
parameters.description: Controls the overall intensity and animation progress of the bloom effect. Animated by GDScript.

parameters.name: memory_pos_uv
parameters.description: Screen-space UV coordinates (0-1) of the memory shard's center. Set by GDScript.

parameters.name: max_radius
parameters.description: Maximum radius of the effect from the memory shard's center.

parameters.name: bloom_intensity
parameters.description: Intensity multiplier for the bloom color.

parameters.name: distortion_strength
parameters.description: Strength of the screen-space distortion/ripple effect.

verdict: A blinding supernova of self, this bloom promises a beautiful, yet disorienting, glimpse into the soul's fractured past, making memory itself a weapon and a vulnerability.
impact: This shader will visually represent the overwhelming and disorienting rush of a lost identity flooding back, transforming memory recovery from a passive event into an active, sensory-overloading experience. It can create moments of vulnerability or strategic choice during high-stakes encounters, as the player grapples with a beautiful but blinding influx of self amidst immediate danger, directly tying visual feedback to the game's core themes of self-loss and survival.
